before.name: Julian Pecora Cardenas
before.description: Julian Pecora Cardenas was arrested by Border Patrol agents on July 6, 2025, after following a convoy from the Coast Guard base in San Pedro toward Orange County. Federal agents accused him and Arturo Hermosillo of conspiring to impede officers, alleging hazardous driving and attempts to block their vehicles. The complaint places the incident in the context of protesters observing immigration-enforcement vehicles and records that Pecora Cardenas was recording the agents. He later described his activity as citizen oversight. At his July 8 initial appearance, the court set a $25,000 appearance bond and remanded him to the U.S. Marshal; bond conditions were filed July 11. On July 29, 2025, the court dismissed the complaint without prejudice and exonerated both defendants' bonds. There was no conviction or imposed sentence in this case.
